lines: Again? Ash on the blade. I keep gear, not lives.
Good, the iron's still here. —Don't make me recognise buried iron twice.
Old debt paid. The fire… burns a little steadier.
Tier-ups still cost gold. Feelings don't burn like charcoal.
That break… you got it from the training yard? Hand it over.
The broken sword is near the weapon rack at the training yard. Don't tell me you got lost.
Meager Edge. Ugly name, works fine. Bring gold for tier-ups.
…If you've got time, take a look at the training yard for me. An old debt.
The door isn't open for sightseeing. The company sent its weakest again?
